[[Droknar's Strength Shield]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from the [[Warrior's Chest]] at the [[Epilogue]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
* This item  has the same shape as a [[Stone Summit Shield]], but uses a unique greenish-grey coloring.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, exact technical replicas for this item are:
*[[Bronze Shield]] from crafters [[Manzo]], [[Honglei Sun]], [[Theodosus]], [[Gertrud]], [[Mathilde]], or [[Telamon]]
*[[Shield of the Lion]] from crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]] or collector [[Kwesi]]
*[[Wooden Buckler]] from collector [[Maddison]]


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create exact technical replicas for this item with:
*One of the following [[Strength]] [[shield]]s:
**[[Militia Shield]] from collector [[Pathfinder Mia]]

**[[Imperial Shield]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Shield]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]

==Unique counterpart==
*[[Bartholos' Bulwark]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Strength)]], [[Shield of the Kinslayer]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Strength Shield]], and [[Mallyx's Courage]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Aegis of the Condemned]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Tactics)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Tactics Shield]], [[Mallyx's Defense]] have identical stats as this item but require [[Tactics]].
*[[Mallyx's Supremacy]], [[Shagu's Anthem]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Command)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Command Shield]], and [[Shield of the Condemned]] have stats identical to is item but require [[Command]].
*[[Cyndr's Aegis]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Motivation)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Motivation Shield]], [[Mallyx's Motivation]], and [[Bastion of the Condemned]] have stats identical to this item but require [[Motivation]].
